s: Kesheen hannokri babbayit eno meakkeb ubo g' seipim: nokri haddar im shene yisreelim bechatzer achat, veen hannokri bebeto (velo shum echad mibbene beto) — eno oser, viarebu veyihyu muttarim. Vaapillu im halak lemaqom qarob, sheepshar sheyyachazor lebeto beshabbat, mikkol maqom kol zeman sheeno bebeto en dirato oseret, sheddira belo bealim enah dira, kemo shennitbaer besimman sha"a. Veim ba hannokri beshabbat — oser, vehaerub batel. Veen omerim "shabbat kevan shehuttera huttera", hoil ubeshaa shehuttera lo haya haddabar barur shello tachazor veteaser, ki shemma yabo hannokri beshabbat, im lo sheyyadua beberur middaat hannokri biknisat shabbat shello haya az bedato lachazor lebeto beshabbat, venimlak achar kak:

Vaapillu im rotzim liskor mimmennu leachar shebba beshabbat — eno moil, ella liksheyyebattel echad lachabero achar shessakeru mimmennu, yihyeh chabero muttar. Abal haerub eno chozer veneor keshessakeru mimmennu, hoil ukebar nitbattel miyyad beboo. Veeno domeh lispinot shehayu qeshurot zo bezo mibbeod yom veerebu yachad, venipsequ beshabbat venitbattel eruban vechazeru veniqsheru, shechazeru lehetteran harishon, kemo shennitbaer besimman shs"b (veken b' chatzerot sheerebu paam achat leshana o yoter al yede petach shebbenehem, venistam happetach bechol veniptach beshabbat, shehaerub chozer veneor, kemo shennitbaer besimman sha"d), lepi shebbeshaa sheerebu hassepinot haqqeshurot, lo hayu omedot lippaseq beshabbat ulehitbattel eruban (veken beshaa sheerebu hachatzerot leshana o yoter, lo haya happetach shebbenehem omed az listom beshana zo o achar kak ulehitbattel eruban). Mah sheen ken kan, shekkevan shebba hannokri beshabbat, im ken mittechilla keshennaasa haerub — lo haya sopo lehitqayyem kol hashshabbat, shekkesheyyabo hannokri yitbattel (vaapillu im halak bederek lemerachoq, yakol hu lelek mimmeqomo bechol velabo beshabbat):

Abal im haya hannokri bebeto, vesakeru mimmennu mibbeod yom veerebu, umet hannokri beshabbat vesakeru bo bayyom min hayyoresh — hare haerub chozer veneor, hoil ubishat asiyyato lo haya hannokri omed lamut beshabbat sheyyeesor alehem yoresh, kevan shessakeru mimmennu. Abal im erebu belo sekirut, shehayu asurim, umet hannokri beshabbat veyoresho eno dar sham, sheeno oser alehem — ap al pi ken asurim ad sheyyebattel echad lachabero veyihyeh chabero muttar. Abal haerub eno chozer veneor, hoil ubishat asiyyato lo haya hannokri omed lamut beshabbat, vegam lepi sheadayin lo qanu erub meolam (ayyen simman sha"d). Veeno domeh leyisrael hambattel reshut lishnayim sheerebu, shehem muttarim, sheerubam chozer veneor, lepi shekkesheereb mibbeod yom haya gam zeh rauy leareb immahem, lepikak eno mebattel erubam kesheshshakach velo ereb immahem. Mah sheen ken nokri sheeno rauy leareb immahem, hu mebattel et erubam keshello hiskir lahem reshuto shebbechatzer. Vekevan shennitbattel mibbeod yom — eno chozer veneor mishshechasheka, sheen meorbim mishshettechshak:
